items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: Well, he played with Johnny Long with the Shillen Band for all time.

ctx.x: From here. He just died about a couple of years ago. I never knew him. I never knew him. Well, he played with Johnny Long with the Shillen Band for all time. He was raised for a damn good drummer.
Yeah. But, well, did you ever play at the Orpheum?
